notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A massive white limestone mountain with a distinctive shape dominates every part of this tiny territory.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: All coverage is Generation 3 with a long antenna tipped in silver; it also exists in parts of Spain.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: White front and yellow rear plates, as in the United Kingdom.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Unlike the United Kingdom, traffic drives on the right.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: The main language on official signs is the one of the United Kingdom, odd to see in a Mediterranean setting; Malta is similar.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Dense Mediterranean-style buildings in pastel colours with louvered shutters painted green, blue or brown.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: All coverage was shot in December, so Christmas decorations are visible in many parts of town.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Wild Barbary macaque monkeys live here, the only wild monkeys in Europe.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Minarets of the southernmost mosque in continental Europe are visible near the southern tip.
